links.comparator_used: Zero-shot prompting (instructions only) vs global few-shot and center-specific few-shot prompting with 2-12 examples, on DeepSeek-V3 and ChatGPT-4o
links.outcome: Field-level macro F1 for information extraction from free-text liver MRI reports
links.effect: Largest macro F1 gain when k rose from 0 to 2 (DeepSeek-V3: global +0.106, center-specific +0.127; ChatGPT-4o: global +0.086, center-specific +0.107). Performance plateaued at k=4 (DeepSeek-V3 global 0.848, center-specific 0.865; ChatGPT-4o global 0.835, center-specific 0.861), with adjacent-k gains <0.01.
links.quote: Few-shot prompting significantly outperformed zero-shot prompting for both LLMs, with the largest gains in macro F1 observed when k was increased from 0 to 2 (∆DeepSeek-V3: global 0.106, center-specific 0.127; ∆ ChatGPT-4o: global 0.086, center-specific 0.107).
